verdict.rationale: Kick documents native invoicing: you can create and send invoices directly from Kick and view invoices synced from Stripe, Mercury, and BILL. AR is included in the Plus plan. Nothing in the evidence shows recurring invoice schedules or automatic reminders for overdue customers, which are the heart of this story. Missing for 10: recurring/scheduled invoice creation, automated overdue payment reminders, AR aging/dunning documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
